limitations: Independent agent walkthroughs, not a human operator study. This walker did not write the guide.

V-M41-PUBLIC live-provider-check rows rest on the claude-live walker's session with the batch owner's claude.ai account (claude-live/v-m41-public.json); this walker did not expose anything publicly. Only claude.ai was connected: ChatGPT and Microsoft 365 Copilot were not tested (owner decision), nor Claude Desktop or Cowork.

Not walked: the scheduled vendor allowlist refresh (no firewall in front of a public listener; the source pages were only read), and the negative check that a cross-host redirect or blocked protocol path prevents the hosted connection.

Private access was tested only from this machine through its LAN and Tailscale addresses, with a fictional CA and resolver overrides instead of internal DNS. No second device, VPN, firewall or IPv6 rule was tested; 'unreachable outside the permitted network' was shown as refused connections after withdrawal and, for the public lab, by the claude-live walker's outside port checks.

The API key Client was curl speaking Streamable HTTP; claude mcp add was not run. Claude Code loopback OAuth was driven at the protocol level with Claude Code's published client ID; the Claude Code binary was not run.
Port 443 needs root on this host and 127.0.0.1:3000 belongs to an unrelated service, so the private origin used :25716 and the default http://localhost:3000 origin was served through Caddy on [::1].
The expired-key check moved expires_at into the past in the database (shortest lifetime is one day). Signing, AI and SSO were not configured, so their wrong-key symptoms were not observed.

Host workarounds, not article steps: Docker address pools were exhausted, so round 2's engine network was created with an explicit subnet; the host rebooted during round 1 and the fixtures were started again.
Failed attempts caused by the reviewer's scripts or by Chromium ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED stay in walkthrough.json beside their passing repeats; failureNotes lists them.

Product bugs recorded in walkthrough.json: the recovery command under a wrong key erases every section; the plain-HTTP OAuth refusal shows no message on the page; the upload refusal says MB for a MiB limit; the API never deletes its heartbeat row.
